name: Default
shortDescription: Open source mail delivery platform for sending transactional and bulk email through an HTTP API and SMTP, with a web interface, delivery tracking and webhooks.

alerts.message: Sign in with ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment settings. The admin account is created only on the first start, so change the password in the web interface afterwards instead of editing the variable.

Only the web interface and HTTP API are public: the SMTP port is not published, so Postal cannot receive inbound mail from the internet. Send through the HTTP API, or over SMTP at postal-smtp:25 from apps in the same environment. Outbound delivery needs port 25 open at your provider and the SPF, DKIM and return path DNS records Postal shows for each domain.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
